panels.Pro_exact_fixed_background_v1: 270370 exact old ordinary Manual replacement events; pool/background/request values inherited unchanged; suitable for fold-training relations and validation only after excluding target building
panels.A_nested_even_v1: 16296 new independently registered events, 4200 actual pair-background chains, 8/12/16/24 supported nodes; suggested extra-background external-fold evaluation only, never local class-number selection

identity_fields.event_id: stable SHA256-derived unique event identity, same row for every class scheme
identity_fields.pool_id: same image, condition, frozen reference ID and version
identity_fields.building: direct original building, used for outer fold exclusion
identity_fields.difficulty: frozen Chinese manual difficulty, independent of new output
identity_fields.reference_id: pool-bound GT reference; never optimized by output
identity_fields.worker_a/worker_b: anonymous entrant IDs in lexicographic orientation a<b; signed changes mean B-A
identity_fields.background_id: exact same k-1 background for both endpoint teams
identity_fields.chain_id: new nested panel identity; old panel empty, must not be falsely treated as cross-k nesting
identity_fields.person_pair_id: fixed unordered pair within new pool
identity_fields.team_id_a/team_id_b: native IDs computed from pool+sorted actual object IDs
identity_fields.ordered_workers_a/ordered_workers_b: actual request order, original fusion sorts selected workers natively
identity_fields.k: same real team size for both endpoints

quality.B8L2_a/B8L2_b: unchanged main scores; unavailable remains empty/null
quality.D10_a/D10_b: fixed member measurement sensitivity, 8 to10 degree direction scale only
quality.floor_iou_change: difference of each team's GT floor IoU, distinct from output-output change
quality.omission_change/extension_change: native GT-relative geometry components, not new human error gold

output_geometry_change.floor_jaccard_difference/floor_change: 1-IoU between the two valid complete output floor polygons
output_geometry_change.floor_symdiff_h2: output floor symmetric difference area in native normalized units
output_geometry_change.structure_bound_cyclic_deg: native max bound upper/lower endpoint angular discrepancy after best shared cyclic shift; main does not allow ring reverse
output_geometry_change.upper_bound_shift_max_deg/lower_bound_sh: upper/lower max discrepancy using that same native bound cyclic shift, not separately optimized matches
output_geometry_change.upper_bound_shift_mean_deg/lower_bound_s: mean upper/lower discrepancy using that native shift
output_geometry_change.edge_relation_jaccard_difference: native shared-original-observation connection relation Jaccard change, not just edge-count difference
output_geometry_change.selected_shared_observation_difference: fraction of shared original observations changing selected status
output_geometry_change.mean_height_prism_pair_iou: two output mean-height prisms' IoU; approximate shape diagnostic
output_geometry_change.height_ratio_pair_abs_logdiff: absolute log ratio of native mean output heights
output_geometry_change.floor_geometry_exactly_equal/full_geomet: native exact canonical output equality flags

completeness.complete_a/complete_b/both_complete: native computable complete geometry, not new manual acceptance
completeness.policy: Failures remain all-attempt denominator; their quality/geometry component values are not filled with zero. Joint stability explicitly False for any endpoint failure.

stability.joint_stable_main/stable_main: both complete, both scored, absolute B8 difference<=2, output floor Jaccard difference<=0.05, same nodes, native bound cyclic discrepancy<=3 degrees
stability.joint_stable_*_orientation_invariant: same tolerance but reverse-orientation allowed diagnostic
stability.CSV_boolean_encoding: True/False from native Python bool; parse as boolean, do not use bool('False')

timing.source_time_*_a/b: source reported/audited time coverage and sums, missing count explicit
timing.target_time_*_a/b: same-target time separately; never substituted by source time
timing.source_time_change_seconds/target_time_c: B-A total only when both endpoints complete for that source
timing.source_entrant_time_a/b/target_entrant_t: actual entering/exiting worker task cost with missing explicit
timing.entrant_origin_a/b: old v1/new source cohort, not a discovered personnel class
timing.entrant_time_source_kind_a/b: provenance of actual source time, not an equivalence assertion

post_answer_fields: all fused output statuses, votes and geometry
leakage_warning: Do not include these post-answer fields in prospective target-person class discovery/selection. Target point-count matching is an explicitly named conditional sensitivity. All historical features, imputations, transformations, class-number selection and rules must exclude heldout building.
